sentences.text:
19 July, 2019
 Honourable Sri Justice D.V.S.S. Somayajulu
 Criminal Petition No.4221 of 2019
Order:

This Criminal Petition is filed, under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, to quash the proceedings against the petitioner-accused in Crime No.352 of 2019 on the file of Gajuwaka Police Station, Visakhapatnam City, for the offences under Sections 188 and 273 IPC, Sections 59(i)
and 59(iii) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (for short, FSS Act).
2. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Public Prosecutor for the respondent-State.
3.
Both the counsels agree that this matter is squarely covered by the judgment of the single Judge in the batch petitions bearing Criminal Petition Nos.3731 of 2018 and others.
The same was also followed in Criminal Petition No.1697 of 2019 and others by the learned single Judges of this Court.

entities.text: Criminal Petition No.1697 of 2019 and others
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: 4. In view of the fact that this matter is squarely covered by the earlier orders, the Criminal Petition is allowed and the proceedings against the petitioner in Crime No.352 of 2019 on the file of Gajuwaka Police Station, Visakhapatnam City, are hereby quashed.
As a sequel, the Miscellaneous Applications, if any pending shall stand closed.

_ _ _ D.V.S.S. SOMAYAJULU, J Date: 19.7.2019 YS Nemani Jagan Mohan Rao vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 19 July, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/92019228/
